-- Customer Segmentation Analysis
-- Analyze customer value, purchasing activity, lifespan, recency,
-- and age to classify customers into meaningful segments.

WITH CustomerAggregation AS (
    SELECT
        C.customer_id,

        -- Combine first and last name to create the customer's full name
        CONCAT(C.first_name, ' ', C.last_name) AS [Customer Name],

        -- Calculate the customer's current age
        DATEDIFF(YEAR, C.birthdate, GETDATE()) AS [Customer Age],

        -- Calculate total sales generated by each customer
        SUM(S.sales_amount) AS [Total Sales],

        -- Count the number of unique orders placed by each customer
        COUNT(DISTINCT S.order_number) AS [Total Orders],

        -- Calculate the total quantity of products purchased
        SUM(S.quantity) AS [Total Quantity],

        -- Count the number of unique products purchased
        COUNT(DISTINCT S.product_key) AS [Total Products],

        -- Calculate the customer's lifespan in months
        -- from their first order to their most recent order
        DATEDIFF(
            MONTH,
            MIN(S.order_date),
            MAX(S.order_date)
        ) AS [Customer Lifespan (Months)],

        -- Calculate the number of months since the customer's most recent order
        DATEDIFF(
            MONTH,
            MAX(S.order_date),
            GETDATE()
        ) AS [Customer Recency (Months)],

        -- Calculate average sales per unit purchased
        SUM(S.sales_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(S.quantity), 0) AS [Average Order Value],

        -- Calculate the customer's average monthly spending
        SUM(S.sales_amount) /
        NULLIF(
            DATEDIFF(MONTH, MIN(S.order_date), MAX(S.order_date)),
            0
        ) AS [Average Monthly Spend]

    FROM dim_customers AS C

    LEFT JOIN fact_sales AS S
        ON C.customer_key = S.customer_key

    -- Aggregate sales information at the customer level
    GROUP BY
        C.customer_id,
        CONCAT(C.first_name, ' ', C.last_name),
        DATEDIFF(YEAR, C.birthdate, GETDATE())
),

CustomerSegmentation AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,

        -- Segment customers based on total sales and customer lifespan
        CASE
            WHEN [Total Sales] > 5000
                 AND [Customer Lifespan (Months)] > 12
                THEN 'VIP Customer'

            WHEN [Total Sales] < 5000
                 AND [Customer Lifespan (Months)] > 12
                THEN 'Regular Customer'

            ELSE 'New Customer'
        END AS [Customer Segment],

        -- Segment customers based on their age
        CASE
            WHEN [Customer Age] > 60
                THEN 'Above 60'

            WHEN [Customer Age] BETWEEN 50 AND 60
                THEN '50-60'

            WHEN [Customer Age] BETWEEN 40 AND 49
                THEN '40-49'

            ELSE 'Below 40'
        END AS [Customer Age Segment]

    FROM CustomerAggregation
)

SELECT
    CA.*,
    CS.[Customer Segment],
    CS.[Customer Age Segment]

FROM CustomerAggregation AS CA

INNER JOIN CustomerSegmentation AS CS
    ON CA.customer_id = CS.customer_id;
